name: Eradicator Valkyrie
oracle_text:
Flying, lifelink, hexproof from planeswalkers
Boast — {1}{B}, Sacrifice a creature: Each opponent sacrifices a creature or planeswalker. (Activate only if this creature attacked this turn and only once each turn.)

needs.what: a parameterised hexproof keyword, 'hexproof from <quality>', where the quality here is a card type (planeswalkers): this permanent can't be the target of spells or abilities opponents control whose source is a planeswalker (702.11d), while remaining targetable by everything else
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The keywords list has only plain 'hexproof' (blocks every opponent source, too broad) and 'shroud'; the 'protection' static effect also prevents damage, blocking and attachment (DEBT), and 'ward' only taxes targeting; nothing restricts untargetability to sources of a given type
